propositions: git merge command in fixture setup intermittently exits with status 1 during pytest xdist execution, but cause is undetermined and content conflict is structurally impossible.

Fixture _git() helper captures git stdout and stderr but discards them when raising CalledProcessError, destroying diagnostic information needed to distinguish between content conflict, hook failure, or unresolvable merge argument.

Attempted reproduction across ~29,400 test executions (1,500 git replays, 40 serial runs, 72 oversubscribed runs, 3 full test rounds under xdist) yielded zero failures, indicating either non-reproducible or extremely rare transient condition.
Both merge sides write byte-identical content for the single shared path (1500-shared01-STATUS.json), verified by git merge-tree --write-tree returning rc=0 with zero conflicts.
CalledProcessError exception message enhanced to include git's stderr, stdout, argv, and exit code so future occurrences will be diagnosable rather than leaving bare exit code.
